instructions: Build a bounded portfolio of proof, corroboration, counterevidence, resolvable decoys and contextual materials. Each item needs a genuine source and role, not arbitrary volume.
Use complementary independent sources rather than requiring a single smoking gun. Initial and gated discovery must follow the actual investigation workflow.
Generated image descriptions and prompts are not observed proof. A decisive visual detail needs validated player-readable representation or a verified multimodal observation.
contract: Every assigned observation is owned by its declared source and appears in its readable content.
Required sources and analyses are compatible and reachable without cycles, private hints or automatic visibility promotion.
Questions and solution claims cite real source IDs and exact supported excerpts.
positiveExample: A receipt corroborates a shift record; a phone-log discrepancy is resolved by an independent interview.
negativeExample: A hidden required clue is made initial to conceal a broken trigger, or a missing observation is appended as fabricated document text.
criteria: Difficulty comes from proof depth, independent paths, ambiguity and investigation order within measurable budgets.
Decoys have a reachable resolution and no unsupported innocence claim.
Every material has complete readable content and a source-appropriate identity.
